subject: Security onboarding: consolidated timebox proposal and vendor alignment
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Burns <elena@fintrust.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 1 May 2029 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Security onboarding: consolidated timebox proposal and vendor alignment

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier — excited to get FinTrust onboarded. To keep the intake efficient for both teams, we propose a consolidated timebox: a single 75-minute session broken into two focused segments (45 min controls + 30 min pen-test scoping) held back-to-back so your team only needs one block on calendar.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue May 7, 09:30–10:45 PT
- Wed May 8, 13:00–14:15 PT

We'd like the RedTeam vendor (cc'd below) to join the second half to align on scope and logistics. Attached: SOC2-questionnaire-v2.xlsx (prefill recommended) and a short onboarding agenda (onboarding-agenda.pdf).

Do either of those windows work? If not, tell me preferred days/times and we can split the sessions. If you have any pre-existing constraints (audit blackout windows, data flow diagrams you'd like us to review ahead of time), please share.

Also: we'll send an NDA DocuSign for signature ahead of the call; let me know if there's an internal procurement contact we should loop in.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire-v2.xlsx, onboarding-agenda.pdf
From: Elena Burns <elena@fintrust.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 2 May 2029 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: consolidated timebox proposal and vendor alignment

Hi Rishi — thanks, this looks good as a starting point. A couple notes from our side:

- We try to avoid late-week blocks due to month-end audit work; Tue May 7 is preferable to Wed May 8.
- Can we keep the total session to 60 minutes? Our security team prefers 45 minutes for controls and a short 15-minute vendor touchpoint to confirm scope.
- Please send a high-level data flow / PII diagram ahead of time if you have one. That helps us triage privacy questions quickly.

Attached is a brief intake doc with constraints (fintrust-intake-constraints.pdf). I can make attendees: myself (security lead), IT Ops (itops@fintrust.com) and Jane Patel (application owner). If you need procurement looped in for the NDA, cc procurement@fintrust.com.

If May 7 09:30 PT is confirmed, I’ll send a calendar invite from our side.

Best,
Elena
Elena Burns
Head of InfoSec, FinTrust Bank
elena@fintrust.com

Thanks Elena — understood on the audit blackout and the tighter slot. To accommodate the ask we can do:

Option A (preferred): May 7, 09:30–10:30 PT
- 09:30–10:15 PT: Controls walkthrough (45 min)
- 10:15–10:30 PT: Vendor quick-scope (15 min)

Option B: Split into two separate meetings (45-min controls + 30-min pen-test kickoff on a different day) if you prefer more time for vendor scoping.

I've attached a pared-down prework checklist too — if you can prefill the questionnaire and share a data-flow diagram that would speed the call. I'll also drop a quick Doodle poll in case the proposed time collides with internal calendars: https://doodle.com/poll/example-fintrust-onboard (poll closes EOD May 3).

Would you like us to send the DocuSign NDA now or after the meeting is scheduled?

—Rishi

From: RedTeam Security <redteam@secvendor.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Burns <elena@fintrust.com>
Date: Fri, 3 May 2029 10:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Security onboarding: consolidated timebox proposal and vendor alignment

Hi all — RedTeam here. We should be able to join for a short vendor touchpoint. Our lead (Samir) is on US Central hours and prefers Mon/Tue slots; May 7 looks okay but May 8 is tight for us.

Quick ask: can you share the scope we expect the pen-test vendor to cover (external perimeter vs. authenticated app-level vs. microservices)? If you provide a one-page scope doc we’ll confirm availability and a shortlist of testing windows.

We can accept the 15-minute vendor sync on May 7 but would appreciate a follow-up 30–60 minute planning session the week after to align on rules of engagement.

Thanks,
RedTeam Security (secvendor)
redteam@secvendor.com
